description: This file defines the class RelationshipHandler, which manages and interacts with relationships between modules in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for setting up relationships, building relationship info, retrieving linked beans, and navigating relationship metadata.

classes.name: RelationshipHandler
classes.description: A class extending Relationship, responsible for managing module relationships within SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It provides methods for setting relationship fields, constructing relationship info, retrieving linked beans, and exploring relationship metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the database connection and optionally the base module.

methods.name: set_rel_vardef_fields
methods.description: Sets the vardef fields for the base and first related module in the relationship.

methods.name: set_rel_relationship_names
methods.description: Sets the relationship names for rel1 and rel2 based on vardef fields.

methods.name: build_info
methods.description: Builds comprehensive relationship information arrays, optionally including rel2 info.

methods.name: build_rel1_info
methods.description: Builds the info array for the first related module.

methods.name: build_rel2_info
methods.description: Builds the info array for the second related module.

methods.name: build_module_labels
methods.description: Translates module labels (singular and plural) for base, rel1, and rel2 modules.

methods.name: build_related_list
methods.description: Retrieves linked beans for base or rel1 modules, potentially using relationship filters.

methods.name: get_relationship_information
methods.description: Retrieves relationship info between the base and a target bean, populating foreign keys accordingly.

methods.name: traverse_rel_meta
methods.description: Finds the ID field name in a target bean that corresponds to a specified relationship.

methods.name: get_id_name
methods.description: Finds the ID name for a relationship field in a target bean.

methods.name: process_by_rel_bean
methods.description: Sets the relationship info by processing a related module name.

methods.name: get_rel1_vardef_field_base
methods.description: Retrieves the base vardef field for rel1 based on relationship definitions.

methods.name: get_farthest_reach
methods.description: Returns the bean object at the farthest reach in the relationship chain, building info as needed.
